units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 5:3">Bekh. V, 3</cite> <he>הצוֹרֵם באוזן וכ׳</he> if one makes a slit in the ear of a firstborn animal.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 5:3">Ib.</cite> <he>נטל … וצ׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00055"><he>פִּגְיוֹן</he></cite>.
Ib. (35ᵃ) הלך וצ׳ באזני וכ׳ (Talm. ed. וצֵירֵם, Pl.) he went and mutilated the ears of other first-born animals.
<cite ref="Zevachim 25b:13">Zeb. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>הצורם אזן הפר</he> if one mutilates the (priest’s sacrificial) bullock; <cite ref="Bekhorot 39b">Bekh. 39ᵇ</cite> (Tosaf. <he>החורם</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 3:8">Tosef. Par. III, 8</cite> <he>צ׳ לו באזנו</he> he slit his ear (to make him unfit for priestly service); a. e.
